title: An alias union with an unmatched generic closer is malformed

ground_truth.statement: An alias must name a valid type expression. First|Second> has an unmatched closing generic delimiter and is not such an expression. Diagnosing the malformed alias is a static documentation policy; PHP ignores this comment at runtime.

provenance.derivation: Retained only the unmatched delimiter with declared alternatives.

notes: No runtime proof can establish a comment parser's policy; runtime only verifies the comment has no execution effect. Psalm reports InvalidDocblock. PHPStan and Mago are silent, retained as policy-comparison FN, not unsupported.
